text: dsh-think-expand 是适用于 DSH 网页端的界面插件，在每个会话标题栏加入独立的 Think 开关。开启后，它展开该会话中包含 Think 内容的步骤分组和折叠轮次，再展开其中的 Think 行；不含 Think 的分组与工具卡片保持原状。你可以逐会话查看或收起推理内容，手动收起的项目会保留选择，关闭开关时插件会收回自己打开的分组和轮次，并收起 Think 行。插件也处理动态出现的内容，并在调整内容时尽量维持阅读位置。适合需要在 DSH 网页会话中集中查看推理过程的用户。需要 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 或更新版本及 web 配置，不需要额外密钥。

dsh-think-expand adds a Think switch to each DSH web conversation. It opens Think rows and their folded groups or turns, while leaving unrelated content alone. Each session is controlled separately; switching off closes what it opened. Requires DSH 0.1.7-rc.2+ with web; no API key.

dsh-think-expand 的功能「会话 Think 开关」：点击会话标题栏的 Think 按钮，切换该会话全部 Think 行的展开状态。开启时也会打开容纳 Think 的折叠分组和轮次。
dsh-think-expand 的功能「尊重手动收起」：开启自动展开后，用户亲手收起的 Think 行、分组或轮次会暂时保持关闭，直到再次切换开关。
dsh-think-expand 的功能「适配新增内容」：启用时观察当前会话内容，遇到新 Think 行或折叠状态变化后重新处理，也会按次数限制重试未生效的展开操作。
dsh-think-expand 的功能「维持阅读位置」：展开或收起内容导致页面高度改变时，插件短暂保持读者视线锚点；用户滚动、触摸或按键后即停止调整。

dsh-think-expand README · dsh-think-expand：[中文](README.md) | [英文](README.en.md)

DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 插件。默认不改动任何东西，Think 行的展开和收起完全由你决定；在某个会话的标题栏点 `Think` 开关，只有这个窗口里的这个会话会展开或收起全部 Think。DSH 0.1.7 起把 Think 收进了步骤分组（例如「执行了命令」「已完成分析」）和折叠的轮次里，开关打开时插件会先打开装有 Think 的分组和轮次，再展开其中的 Think。工具卡片、上下文注入、压缩行不会被打开。

dsh-think-expand README · 安装：需要 `dsh` 0.1.7-rc.2 或更新版本，以及 `web` 配置。已在官方 0.2.1-rc.4 网页端上实测，同时装有 dsh-claude-style 0.19.5 主题。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:BrianHIO-x/dsh-think-expand
```

本地目录：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-think-expand
```

重新启动 `dsh web`。主机终端应出现 `[dsh-think-expand] plugin loaded!`。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-think-expand
```

dsh-think-expand README · 开关的作用范围：- 开关默认关闭。关闭时插件不监听页面，也不碰任何 Think 行，展开和收起全部按 DSH 原本的方式由你手动操作。
- 每个会话有自己的开关，只作用于当前窗口主区域里的这个会话。打开某个会话的开关，其他会话保持关闭。
- 子智能体也一样：在主区域打开子智能体会话时，它的开关默认关闭，可以单独打开。右侧边栏里打开的子智能体会话没有标题栏，所以没有开关，插件也不会去动它，那里的 Think 一直由你手动展开。
- 开关状态只保存在当前窗口的内存里。切到别的会话再切回来，原来的开关状态还在；新开的窗口和刷新后的页面，所有会话的开关都重新从关闭开始。旧版本保存在浏览器里的全局开关会被清除。

dsh-think-expand README · 开关打开后：- 只匹配官方 Think 行（`data-variant="think"`）。
- 插件会打开装有 Think 的步骤分组和折叠的轮次（「用时 X 分 X 秒」那一行），然后只展开其中的 Think。分组里的工具行保持收起，不含 Think 的分组保持折叠。
- 一轮结束后 DSH 会自动折叠这一轮，开关打开时插件会把它重新打开。
- 手动收起的 Think 行、分组或轮次会保持收起，直到下一次点开关。
- 关掉开关时，插件收起这个会话的全部 Think，并把它自己打开过的分组和轮次折叠回去；你自己打开的分组和轮次不受影响。
- 插件打开分组和轮次时不会移动焦点，对话不会因此跳动。
- 开关打开时，步骤分组跟着内容一起变高，整段对话作为一个整体滚动。DSH 给展开的分组设了最高 400 像素、带独立滚动条的盒子，全部展开后滚轮会被这些盒子接走，往上滑时页面几乎不动，「加载更早」载入的历史也就看不到。开关关闭的会话保持 DSH 原本的样子。
- 插件展开或收起内容时会保住你正在看的位置：你上方的内容变长或变短，视野里的那一行留在原处。点「加载更早」后，你停在原来的位置，更早的内容在上方，和 DSH 原本的行为一致。你一滚动、点击或按键，插件立刻不再干预；跟随最新输出时由 DSH 自己处理。
- 只有你亲手的点击和按键才算手动操作。其他插件用程序触发的展开或收起（例如主题在思考结束后自动收起 Think 行）不会被记成你的选择，开关打开时插件会把这些行重新展开。
- 兼容给折叠加动画的主题（例如 dsh-claude-style）。这类主题会在动画期间吞掉对话区的点击，所以插件用 Think 行自带的回车键切换它，不经过点击；分组和轮次的点击如果被吞掉，插件会在动画结束后重试，每个控件最多 5 次。

dsh-think-expand README · 性能：- 开关关闭的会话，插件不做任何工作。
- 开关打开时，插件只观察这一个会话的对话区。流式输出的正文和正在写入的思考内容不会触发扫描，只有新的 Think 行出现、或者有分组、轮次、Think 行被折叠或展开时，插件才检查一次。

dsh-think-expand README · dsh-think-expand：DeepSeek Harness Web plugin. By default it changes nothing and leaves every Think row to you. Press the `Think` switch in a session's header and only that session, in that window, opens or closes all of its Think rows. Since DSH 0.1.7, Think rows live inside step groups and folded turns, so with the switch on the plugin first opens the groups and turns that hold a Think row, then expands the Think rows inside. Tool cards, context injections, and compaction rows stay as they are.

dsh-think-expand README · Install：Needs `dsh` 0.1.7-rc.2 or later and the `web` profile. Tested on the official 0.2.1-rc.4 web UI, with the dsh-claude-style 0.19.5 theme installed.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:BrianHIO-x/dsh-think-expand
```

Local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-think-expand
```

Restart `dsh web`. The host terminal should print `[dsh-think-expand] plugin loaded!`.

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-think-expand
```

dsh-think-expand README · What the switch covers：- The switch starts off. While it is off the plugin watches nothing and touches no Think row; you open and close them by hand, as in plain DSH.
- Each session has its own switch, and it acts only on that session in this window's main area. Turning it on for one session leaves every other session off.
- Subagents work the same way: a subagent session opened in the main area starts with its switch off and can be turned on on its own. A subagent chat opened in the right Sidebar has no header and so no switch; the plugin leaves it alone, and its Think rows stay under your control.
- Switch states live in this window's memory only. Leave a session and come back and its switch is as you left it; a new window or a reload starts every session off. The old browser-wide switch from earlier versions is removed.

dsh-think-expand README · With the switch on：- Matches the official Think row only (`data-variant="think"`).
- The plugin opens every step group and folded turn (its elapsed-time line) that holds a Think row, then expands only the Think rows. Tool rows inside stay collapsed, and groups without a Think row stay folded.
- DSH folds a turn when it finishes; with the switch on, the plugin opens it again.
- A Think row, group, or turn you close by hand stays closed until you press the switch again.
- Turning the switch off collapses every Think row in that session and refolds the groups and turns the plugin opened. Groups and turns you opened yourself stay open.
- Opening groups and turns never moves focus, so the conversation does not jump.
- With the switch on, step groups grow with their content and the conversation scrolls as one page. DSH caps an open group at 400 pixels with its own scrollbar; with every group open, the wheel kept landing in those boxes, the page barely moved when scrolling up, and history brought in by "Load earlier" never came into view. Sessions whose switch is off keep DSH's own look.

dsh-think-expand README · Performance：- A session whose switch is off costs nothing.
- With the switch on, the plugin observes that one session's chat area. Streaming answer text and reasoning being written do not trigger a scan; the plugin checks again only when a new Think row appears or a group, turn, or Think row folds or unfolds.
